# Remote Control Agent v0.1.35

This reviewed follow-up preserves the completed cancellation of Browser Handoff (Spec #280) and the owner-selected **device-local one-click upgrade** path (Agent Issue #39 canceled).

- Correct `rca status` / `rca logs` for retained historical `remote-control-v2-agent.service` installations; reject conflicting canonical and historical units rather than guessing.
- When explicitly upgrading a signed historical Linux service, atomically update the trusted `~/.local/bin/rca` launcher after the validated service switch, preserving the old launcher and recovery information on failure.
- Remove obsolete MCP remote-upgrade admission/dispatch from the Agent runtime and omit remote-only helpers from new native Release bundles, while preserving verified local Windows/Linux installers, checksums, rollback and identity/receipt protections.
- Clarify the canceled Spec #280 design documentation without reviving its Controller, Quick Tunnel OTP, state machine or MCP tools.
- Keep the original Remote Control browser, file, Shell and device pairing capabilities. No paired device is re-enrolled.

This immutable GitHub prerelease **does not** modify any installed device, paired identity, Worker production pin or local systemd/Windows Task. Device-local upgrades must be explicitly run in the owner's real interactive terminal, using an independently reviewed Worker installer pin and checking unchanged signed UUID, receipts and service state.
